chapter.verse: “Ute naute leh pate aw, tu-ni ka mawhna kiphelh nading kong genna thu hong ngai ta un,” a ci hi.
Hebru pau-in a gen mite in a zak uh ciangin pau lo semsemin a om uh hi.

Paul in a gen-inah: “Kilikia gam, Tarsas khua-a suak, Judah mi ka hi hi. Ahih hangin hih khua sungah Gamaliel’ khe kiangah anvaakna ngahin, i pu i pate’ thukhamte sinin a siamsa ka hi a, tuni-a note khatpeuh peuh zahin Pasian’ ading a hahkat mipa ka hi hi.
Hih lampi a zui numei leh pasal henin, thong sungah khumin, a sih dongin ka bawlsia hi.

Hih thu ah siampi liante leh upate khempeuh in kei lamah teci ahi uh hi. Amaute kiang panin zong ute naute kiangah vaikhakna lai ka ngah khit ciangin Damaskas khua-ah a omte zong daantat dingin, henin, Jerusalem khua-ah paipih dingin ka pai hi.
“Lampi ka pai lai takin Damaskas khua ka naih ciangin, sun lai takin vantung panin khuavak a taang mahmah ka kimkot ah thakhatin hong taang hi.
Lei tungah ka puk ciangin, ‘Saul aw, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?’ ci-in hong ci aw ka za hi.
‘Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?’ ci-in ka dot ciangin, ‘Na bawlsiat, Nazareth khua mi, Zeisu ka hi hi,’ hong ci hi.
Keimah tawh a tonkhawmte in khuavak a muh uh hangin kei kiangah hong genpa’ aw a za kei uh hi.

Keimah in zong, ‘Topa aw, bang ka hih ding hiam?’ ci-in ka dot ciangin, ‘Tho in la, Damaskas khua sungah na tum ding hi. Tua khua panin na nasep ding vaikhakna thu khempeuh hong kihilh ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua khuavak khauh luatna hangin ka mit in khua mu zo lo ahih ciangin ka tonpihte in khut tawh hong kai-in, Damaskas khua-ah ka tung uh hi.
“Tua lai takin thukham lamsangah mawhsakna a om lo, tua san takah a om Judah mi khempeuh tungah minphatna a ngah,
Ananias in hong pai a, kei kiangah ding-in ‘Sanggampa Saul aw, na mit in khua mu ta hen! hong cih ciangin, thakhatin amah ka mu thei hi.
Amah in zong, ‘I pu i pate’ Pasian in ama deihna na theih ding ahi zongin, ama Mi Siangtho na muh ding ahi zongin, ama kam sung pan aw na zak ding ahi zongin, nangmah hong koih zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, na muh teng, na zak teng, mi khempeuh mai-ah amah ading teci na hi ding hi.
Tu-in zong bang ngak na hi hiam? Tho in, kibaptaiz in la, Pasian kiangah thugenin, na mawhna na kisawpsiang ding hi,’ hong ci hi.
“Tua nung ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah ka tun’ ciangin biakna innpi sungah thu ka nget lai takin mang ka mu a,
‘Nang thakhatin Jerusalem khua pan a manlangin na paikhia in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, keima thu na genna amaute in hong sang kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in Pasian in hong gen ka mu hi.
Keimah in zong, ‘Topa aw, nangmah hong umte thong sungah ka khum a, kikhopna inn khempeuh sungah ka sat hi ci-in amaute in hong thei uh hi.
Nangma teci Stefen’ si a kibuak lai takin, a kiangah ding-in ka thukim tham loin, a that mite’ puan ka cing hi,’ ci-in ka gen ciangin,
amah in, ‘Paikhia in. Gentailte kiangah gamlapi-ah nang kong sawl ding hi,’ hong ci hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Hih thute a gen khit dongin amaute in a ngai uh hi. Tua ciangin, “Hih bang mipa, leitung pan paaikhia mang un’. Amah a hing dingin a kilawm kei hi!” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko uh hi.
Amaute kiko uh a, amau puan suahkhia-in leivui van lamah a lot uh ciangin galkap mangpa in
bang hangin kiko ahi uh hiam cih a theih nadingin, satna tawh Paul thu a kidot nadingin galkap inn sungah tumpih dingin thu a pia hi.
Amaute in Paul savun khau tawh a hen khit uh ciangin Paul in a kiangah a ding bupa kiangah, “Thukhenna thuak loin Rom mi sat ding a kilawm hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Galkap bupa in tua thu a zak ciangin galkap mangpa kiangah pai a, “Bang na cih ding hiam? Hih mi in Rom mi ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in Paul kiangah pai a, “Nang, Rom mi na hi takpi hiam?” a cih ciangin, “Ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in, “Dangka tampi pia-in hih nam min ka ngah hi,” a cih ciangin Paul in, “Ka pian’na panin Rom mi ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin thu dong dinga akisa mite in Paul kiang panin a paikhia pah uh hi. Amah Rom mi ahih thei a, amah khau tawh hen zo ahih ciangin galkap mangpa a lau mahmah hi.

A zing ciangin bang hangin Judah mite in Paul a mawhsak uh hiam cih galkap mangpa in tel takpi thei nuamin Paul khahkhia a, siampi liante leh upate a kikhopsak khit ciangin paipihsuk a, amaute mai-ah a koih hi.
